The '''''Dauntless''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that, along with four other similar ships, was assigned to a special task force in [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vanko]]'s sector. Sent to stave piracy, the ''Dauntless'', [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']], [[Invincible (Star Destroyer)|''Invincible'']], and [[Triumphant (Star Destroyer)|''Triumphant'']] were to receive [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]] starfighters from the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[Sentinel (Deep Space Manufacturing Facility)|Sentinel]]. The transfer was interrupted by a raid from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] starfighters bound on destroying the ''TIE Advanced'' fighters while they were flown to the ''Dauntless'' by untrained workers. If the Rebel starfighters are unsuccessful in destroying enough "TIE Advanced" then their last option is to send in the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Rehz'nor]] which will send X-wings and Y-wings in an attempt to destroy the Dauntless.

[[Commanding officer/Legends|Commanded]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orsk]], it additionally served as [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] to [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]].<ref name="DauntlessCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
While the occurrence of the space battle depicted in this mission, as well as the participants, is C-[[Canon]], the outcome depends on the actions of the player and is therefore indeterminate. For lack of other canonical information it should be assumed that no lasting effect (such as the destruction of the station or a starship) resulted from the battle.
